tei:div.tei:p: mdos byin brlabs dang lhan thabs bcas pa bzhugs so: bdag lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum spros te: hūṃ las raṃ 'phros pas raṃ 'od du zhu me 'bar bas mdos kyi dngos po dang mtshan ma rnams bsreg: raṃ dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal la raṃ/ hūṃ las yaṃ 'phros 'od du zhu rlung du gyur mdos kyis dngos po dang bag chags ngan pa thams cad gtor: yaṃ maṇ+ḍal yaṃ/ hūṃ las khaṃ 'phros 'od du zhu chur gyur mdos kyi dngos po dang rnam par rtog pa ma lus pa bkrus: khaṃ maṇ+ḍal khaṃ: oṃ swa bha wa= glud rdzas shin tu dag par bsam pa chos nyid rnam dag gi ting nge 'dzin du gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo= 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i longs spyod mi zad pa 'byung ba nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta= nam mkha'i mdzod de las so so'i thugs bzhed ji lta ba mod la dbang po lnga'i bdud rtsi'i dug lnga'i gsos su ci yang 'byung bar gyur/ na ma: sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki= mgron rnams rang rang mdun du mchod rdzas ci 'dod pa thams cad 'byung bar gyur: oṃ dz+nyā na a ba lo ki te na maḥ sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi saṃ bha ba ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa: bdag gi lus zhing rdul kyi grangs su song bas yar mchod mar snying rje'i mgron thams cad la pham rgyal med pa blo kha rdzogs par phul bar 'gyur: na ma: sa man+ta bud+dha naṃḥ gra he shwa ri pra bañdza ti ma hā sa ma ye swā hā: mgron thams cad la bdag gis gtong grogs ci dgos pa byed par gyur: nang ltar 'bru lngas spel ba ni/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ las ye shes lnga dang ldan par gyur: bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang dang ldan par gyur: traṃ las 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par 'gyur: hrīḥlas gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan par gyur: āḥlas bza' btung bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang ldan par gyur:

gzugs brnyan rnams srog chags dngos su bsgyur te lus mdzes shing lta na sdug pa: ngag snyan pa: yid dwangs pa: lag na 'dod yon lnga'i rdzas thogs pa: re re la yang mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros nas: rgyal ba rgya mtsho: snang srid ma mo: rigs drug sems can: bu lon lan chags kyi bdag po: snang srid lha 'dre thams cad re re la yang 'dod yon gling bzhi ri rab skye 'gro sems can 'dod yon gyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa re re la yang so so'i spyod yul dang mthun par gyur: na mo bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag brjod nas gser skyems ni: kyai| gsan cig dgongs shig srid pa'i lha dang 'dre: 'di ring bdag gis bdud rtsis skyems mchod do: skyabs mchog bla ma rnams ni mgron du gnyer: rgyal ba dgongs pa brgyud pa man chad nas: gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa yan chad kyis: rtsa brgyud bla ma'i rigs su rtogs pa la: gser skyems 'bul lo mgon dang skyabs mdzod cig: kyai| yi dam lha tshogs thams cad mgron du gnyer: zhi ba rdor dbyings lha tshogs man chad nas: khrag 'thung khro bo yab yum yan chad du: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus thams cad la: gser skyems 'bul lo dngos grub rnams gnyis stsol: kyai| dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad mgron du gnyer: mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo man chad nas: gnas dang yul gyi ḍak+ki yan chad du: mkha' 'gro'i rigs su rtogs pa thams cad la: gser skyems 'bul lo 'phrin las rgyas par mdzod: kyai| chos skyong bka' bsrung thams cad mgron du gnyer: dpal 'bar ma hā kā la man chad nas: bka' bsrung gter bdag thams cad yan chad du: bka' bsrung dam can rigs su rtogs pa la: gser skyems 'bul lo 'gal rkyen bar chad bsrung : kyai| steng phyogs lha yi rigs rnams mgron du gnyer: lha chen tshangs pa brgya byin man chad nas: lha phran sil ma pho mo yan chad du: lha yi rigs su rtogs pa thams cad la:

gser skyems 'bul lo bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: kyai| nag po bdud kyi tshogs rnams mgron du gnyer: bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong can man chad nas: bdud po nag po krag med yan chad kyi: bdud kyi rigs su rtogs pa thams cad la: gser skyems 'bul lo bar chad bsrungs par mdzod: kyai| gshin rje'i dam can tshogs rnams mgron du gnyer: thub pa chos kyi rgyal po man chad nas: las byed shan pa dmar nag yan chad du: gshin rje'i rigs su rtogs pa thams cad la: gser skyems 'bul lo skyabs dang mgon mdzod cig /kyai| drang srong gza'i rigs rnams mgron du gnyer: khyab 'jug chen po ra hu man chad nas: pi ṭi pa tra la sogs yan chan du: gza' yi rigs su gyur pa thams cad la: gser skyems 'bul lo skyabs dang mgon mdzod cig: kyai| nor bdag gnod sbyin tshogs rnams mgron du gnyer: zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul man chad nas: gnod sbyin stong sde'i tshogs rnams yan chad du: gnod sbyin rigs su gyur pa thams cad la: gser skyems 'bul lo ci bsam 'grub par mdzod: kyai| nag po klu yi tshogs rnams mgron du gnyer: klu bdud nā ga rak+ṣa man chad nas: klu phran sil ma'i tshogs rnams yan chad du: klu yi rigs su gyur pa thams cad la: gser skyems 'bul lo rkyen dang bar chad bsrungs: kyai| 'gyogs pa btsan gyi rigs rnams mgron du gnyer: btsan rgod rbed gdong lcam dral man chad nas: ya ma skyabs bdun 'khor bcas yan chad du: btsan gyis rigs su gyur pa thams cad la: gser skyems 'bul lo mgon dang skyabs gnyen mdzod: kyai| srog bdag rgyal po tshogs rnams mgron du gnyer: dgra lha dpe dkar chen po man chad nas: rgyal po sil ma drug cu yan chad du: rgyal po'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad la/ gser skyems 'bul lo mthun rkyen grub tu gsol: kyai| gnyan gyis rigs rnams ma lus mgron du gnyer: gnyan chen thang lha yā zhu man chad nas:

dman chen spom ra 'khor bcas yan chad du: gnyan gyis rigs su rtogs pa thams cad la: gser skyems 'bul lo bdag gis gtong grogs mdzod: bdag lhar gsal ba'i thugs kha'i hūṃ las bh+ruṃ kha mdog sna lnga pa zhig 'phros ste sgrub rdzas rnams la phog de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod tshur 'dus sems can rnams la phog 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ mi dmigs par gyur/ stong nyid de'i ngang las bh+ruṃ bhi shwa bi shud+dhe rat+na maṇ+ḍal bh+ruṃ/ bh+ruṃ 'od du zhu ba las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang sgo bzhi gru bzhi rta bab bzhi ldan/ rtsig pa lnga ldan 'pha' dgu mda' g.yab shar bu chos 'khor gdugs tog ri dwags zung dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i mthar pad 'dab brgyad gdan nyi zla dang bcas par skyed/ bdag gi thugs kha nas oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ laṃ ma ma ma ma/ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ/ bā bā bā bā/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes 'phags pa rnams mchod 'od zer tshur bsdus lha so so'i phyag mtshan du gyur de dag 'od du zhu ba las chu las nya ltar lha tshogs rnams dbus su kun bzang yab yum/ mdun du snang mdzad/ shar rdor sems/ lho rin chen 'byung*/ nub snang mtha'/ byang don 'grub/ de'i phyogs bzhir yum chen/ shar du dkar mo dbu dgu ma/ lhor mtsho sman rgyal mo/ nub tu nag mo rims bdag mo/ byang du smug mo dbu lnga ma/ de'i phyogs bzhir rgyal chen bzhi/ zur bzhir las mkhan bzhi/ sgo bzhir sgo ma bzhi dang*/ byang shar mtshams su dpal ldan 'dod khams kyi bdag mo re ma ti 'khor dang bcas par skyed/ gtso 'khor de rnams gyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūṃ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin ye shes kyi gnas nas badz+ra sa mā dza: oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ hūṃ swā aṃ āḥ dbang bskur spyi ltar mdzad dgos gzhung na gsal/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/

ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi khams rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di dag 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pa ma 'byung bar du bzhugs nas/ gang gi mthong ba dang thos pa dang reg pa thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam la 'god par mdzad du gsol/ ye dhar= su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swā hā//
